processing_steps.atmosphere: 10^-5 mbar pressure, backfilled with argon gas atmosphere
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Remelted 5–6 times inside the arc melter (AM500-Edmund Buhler GmbH, Germany) without breaking vacuum for better elemental intermixing
Relatively high-speed hot rolling at 10 rpm (vs 1 rpm in the previous case)
Cold rolling reduces thickness by 1 mm after high-speed HR
Annealing at 900 °C for 15 min followed by water quenching (modified route after high-speed HR + CR)

structures.overall_structure: Modified A15 (900 °C/15 min anneal): refined B2 stringer bands in a softer γ-matrix (64% γ); B2 present as stringer bands (11%), intragranular IG-B2 (3.7%) and intergranular GB-B2 (16%).

phases_present.morphology: matrix; URE-γ pancake-shaped grains elongated along prior RD retained after annealing

precipitates.distribution: intergranular coarse/irregular GB-B2 at grain boundaries; 16%

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Strain and GND localize preferentially in softer γ and at γ/B2 interfaces; higher dislocation density in γ than in B2 after interrupted tensile at e=0.05

interfaces.slip_behavior: Both γ and B2 co-deform; strain concentration higher in softer γ; two-stage strain hardening with weak yield point elongation

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: ASTM E8; gauge length 12.5 mm, gauge width 3 mm, thickness 2 mm; rolling direction (RD)
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Interrupted tensile tests at engineering strain = 0.05 for A15

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: Engineering stress–strain curves of modified HR/CR/annealed samples shown in Figure 6a (panel not supplied in provided text)

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: B2 stringer band fraction reduced from 16% to 11%; softer γ dominates (64%); reduced crack susceptibility in deformed tensile gauge

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: 100 kN Instron 5982 with 10 mm gauge extensometer
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: room temperature, 1 mm/min crosshead velocity, ASTM E8, rolling direction (RD)

characterization_methods.purpose: Fracture/crack analysis of deformed tensile gauge
characterization_methods.key_findings: B2 stringer bands aligned along RD; microcrack at specimen edge; reduced crack susceptibility in modified A15

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: JEOL JEM 3200 FS operated at 300 kV
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: A15 after interrupted tensile at engineering strain = 0.05
characterization_methods.purpose: Compare dislocation density in γ vs B2
characterization_methods.key_findings: Higher dislocation density in γ than in B2; ellipsoidal B2 particles embedded in deformed γ matrix

characterization_methods.technique: EBSD phase map + Kernel average misorientation (KAM) map
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: FESEM (Apreo S) with routine EBSD setup
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: A15 after interrupted tensile at e=0.05
characterization_methods.key_findings: GND localization at γ/B2 interfaces; strain concentration higher in γ

characterization_methods.technique: Holloman's plot (ln σ vs ln ε) analysis
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: true stress-true strain curves converted from tensile data
characterization_methods.purpose: Determine two-stage strain hardening exponent n
characterization_methods.key_findings: A15: n = 0.064 (initial, due to YPE) then n = 0.25 (second stage)

computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: Pseudo-binary phase diagram for the Fe-10Al-15Mn-0.8C-5Ni multicomponent system; temperature 600–1400 °C, C 0–1.6 wt%
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: Outputs consistent with Ref. [15] for the same alloy composition

unmapped_findings: For modified A15 specifically, individual YS/UTS/elongation/toughness values are not tabulated in the supplied text; only the two-stage strain-hardening exponents (n = 0.064 then n = 0.25) are explicitly A15-specific.
